getRecommendations.description: The `getRecommendations` function retrieves product recommendations based on various parameters such as page type, current SKU, cart items, and user history. The function calls the GraphQL recommendations query and transforms the response into a standardized format. The function calls the [`recommendations`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/products/queries/recommendations/) query.
getRecommendations.events: Emits the `recommendations/data` event with the transformed recommendations data as the payload.

params.description: Parameters for retrieving recommendations including `pageType` (where recommendations are shown), `currentSku` (product being viewed), `cartSkus` (items in cart), `userPurchaseHistory` (previous purchases), and `userViewHistory` (previously viewed products).

publishRecsItemAddToCartClick.description: The `publishRecsItemAddToCartClick` function publishes an event when a user adds a recommended product to their cart, used for tracking recommendation performance.

params.description: Parameters for the add-to-cart event including the recommended product details and recommendation unit information.
